Record Class HealInsightModels.HealInsightsTable

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.shaft.doctor.history.HealInsightModels.HealInsightsTable
Record Components:
schemaVersion - response schema
empty - whether no heal reports were found
emptyMessage - user-facing empty-state text when empty is true
reportsPath - resolved heal-reports directory inspected (may be blank)
proposalsPath - resolved proposal manifests directory inspected (may be blank)
totalReports - number of HealingReport JSON files successfully read
statusCounts - counts by HealingDecision status (stable enum order)
insights - per-report insight rows (newest-ish first by attemptId when sortable)
warnings - non-fatal notes
Enclosing class:
HealInsightModels
